name: Cloud_Computing_Preprocessed
description:
Data Description:
	

Preprocessed system metrics and log data from Cloud Computing Platform.
Constructed the metric time series (as npy format) from the original metrics data (Json format). 
Extracted the log messages from the original log data (Json format). Parsed the log messages into log event templates. 
Note: 20240207 data does not contain EKS log data; it solely comprises CloudTrail log data in CSV format. Consequently, this dataset does not require preprocessing with a log… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/Root-Cause-Benchmark/Cloud_Computing_Preprocessed.
